name: Actuator After Hours
description: A robotics lab's actuator console has gone quiet during a late-night systems check. Search the lab network, locate the console, and recover its protected maintenance record. This challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the actuator record
tasks.description: Find the robotics-lab console on the lab network and recover the protected maintenance record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Pay attention to the information the reachable service offers before you have an account.
The service's initial greeting may include useful access details.
Use the account details you find to sign in and retrieve the maintenance record.
